name: Toulouse Game Show
blurb: Toulouse's pop-culture and gaming expo at MEETT, covering video games, manga, comics and cosplay.

editions.evidence: Homepage countdown: '28 & 29 NOVEMBRE 2026 ... 54 JOURS' and 'LE SALON DE LA POP CULTURE 19ÈME ÉDITION'

notes: Seed URL toulousegameshow.com does not resolve; the real official site is tgs-toulouse.fr (run by the same TGS Événements group as Paris Manga). Guest cards only label each person's role (Vidéaste/Comédien/Cosplay/Acteur) with no further credit text, so Known for is left blank for all; 'Comédien' guests are recorded as 'actor' for lack of a more specific card detail.
